{{Quote|She takes the commission, and soon word comes to Brentaal of her achievements&mdash;a clear path through the dangerous Crombach Nebula, a treaty with the Nalroni of Celanon, and the discovery of a reliable route connecting Serenno and Telos (Chorus: "A Daughter of Brentaal").|Excerpts from the program for the [[2 ABY/Legends|38:2:13]] premiere of ''The Kallea Cycle''|<ref name="Atlas" />}}
The '''Crombach Nebula''' was located within the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Irmenu]]. The [[Battle of Crombach Nebula/Legends|Battle of Crombach Nebula]] was fought within the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. 

==Description==
The Crombach Nebula was situated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]] along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], which served as the dividing line between the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] and [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] regions.<ref name="Atlas" /> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Irmenu]]<ref name="ZotR" /> and its [[Irmenu system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> were located in the fringes of the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]].<ref name="ZotR" />

==History==
In [[3705 BBY/Legends|3705 BBY]], the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] [[Star map/Legends|charted]] a path through the dangerous Crombach Nebula to form part of the Hydian Way by connecting the [[Mandalorian Road]] and [[Sprizen End Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] that bordered the nebula. Twenty-two [[Standard century/Legends|hundred]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, the [[Musician/Legends|composer]] [[Trebian Shullos]] [[Author/Legends|wrote]] ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]'', an [[Opera/Legends|opera]] that depicted the difficulties Kallea overcame to chart the the extensive hyperlane. In the first act of the [[Music/Legends|opera]], titled "The [[First Hall of Brentioch|Hall of Brentioch]]," Kallea is commissioned by her friend [[Sival Brentioch]] to join together the unreliable [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] lanes between the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] and [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] rim. Her first achievement, which included finding a clear path through the Crombach Nebula, was celebrated in the following part of the opera's first act.<ref name="Atlas" />

[[File:Munificentcrosssection.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The ''Tide of Progress XII'' (pictured) participated in the Battle of Crombach Nebula of the Clone Wars.]]
At one point. Irmenu became one of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] many lost [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] before it was eventually rediscovered. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="ZotR" /> a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] that was fought from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> the [[Battle of Crombach Nebula/Legends|Battle of Crombach Nebula]] was fought within the Crombach Nebula.<ref name="ROTS: ICS" /> During the battle, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wom-Nii Gnaden/Legends|Wom-Nii Gnaden]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]]<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I|348|Gnaden, Wom-Nii}}</ref> when his [[NTB-630 naval bomber/Legends|NTB-630 naval bomber]] crashed into the [[Tide of Progress XII/Legends|''Tide of Progress XII'']], a Separatist [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] that survived the skirmish.<ref name="ROTS: ICS" /> 

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|The legends of my homeworld of Irmenu speak of the great mariner Darakaer, who sleeps until the faithful summon him by drumming out their call for help.|Natasi Daala|<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
The planet Irmenu had a population of around five million [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. After the planet was rediscovered, it had a single [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that allowed contact with the rest of the galaxy. The [[Irmenu (people)|Irmenu people]] used this contact to exile people to other worlds that ran afoul of their society's customs. This included [[Walon Vau]], who went on to become a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], and [[Natasi Daala]], who became an Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]].<ref name="ZotR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Crombach Nebula was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', a [[2005]] reference book written by [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="ROTS: ICS" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the nebula in grid square O-6.<ref name="Atlas" /> A section mentioning the nebula was cut from the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]. The section was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="ZotR" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] that contained various cut content from the book.<ref name="ZotR" />
